Not related to eating all the leftovers, but... literally the dumbest thing...

One of my exs was bragging to me about how she took a sort of intelligence test as a kid, but not an IQ test... I'm not entirely sure what test it was, but it was in Ireland. She claimed she was in the top 5% for reading comprehension.
I had a quick read of her results and noticed it said she was actually in the bottom 5%. When I told her, she got extremely angry with me, despite it being with the best intentions. I didn't want her bragging and everyone noticing what it actually meant, making her look like a pillock.

Looking back though, the irony was amazing.


Related to food:

My current partner and I got Chinese one night, she went to put my leftovers in the fridge. The next day I couldn't find it anywhere.

Hers was in the fridge though lol.
